name: YSDBBDC YM01 Earphone
description:
Easy to take to anywhere. Support the use of Earphone/Headphone
Super bass sound quality effects
Top ABS Material
Rubber effects painting
With capsule support to close and open up
Company with MP3/MP4/MP5/iPad/iPhone/Computer and other player
Fashion and environment design
Leather look pouch
Pouch - Great for keeping Earphones/Headphones in.
Pouch - Can be used for any small items.
Pouch - Approx sizs- 9x9 cm

If have any manufacturing defect then 7 days replacement Gurranty (If products have found any spot or damage then not returnable)
